note: Phase 10B Sections 14-15: fresh-process repetitions, SmolLM2-135M, ctx=2048, generation tok/s. Vulkan: 7 reps/mode, gen-tokens=128, gpu-layers=all. CPU: 5 reps/mode, gen-tokens=128.
conclusion: No meaningful performance cost for either Q5 variant on either backend -- every delta vs Q8 (-3.6% to +2.0%) is within or close to the modes' own run-to-run stddev. Performance is not a differentiator among q8/q5_0/q5_1/q4 at this model/context size; the trade-off is entirely memory-vs-quality.
